name: MXR M133 Micro Amp (1975, Reference Series)
description: MXR M-133 Micro Amp clean boost: a single non-inverting TL061 stage. 22 MΩ input pull-down (R1) and 10 MΩ bias (R2) to a 4.5 V divider give about 6.8 MΩ input impedance; C1 0.1 µF into R3 1 kΩ to the + input. Feedback is R4 56 kΩ with C2 47 pF across it (60 kHz pole); the gain leg is C3 4.7 µF in series with R6 2.7 kΩ and the 500 kΩ reverse-log Boost pot, so DC gain is 1 and AC gain is 1 + 56k/(2.7k + Rpot), i.e. 1.11x to 21.7x (0.8 dB to 26.2 dB). C5 15 µF, R9 470 Ω and R10 10 kΩ make the output network (about 0.54 kΩ output impedance, 1.06 Hz high-pass). The stock pedal has no LED or DC jack; D1 1N4001 is reverse-polarity protection only. The 9 V battery feeds the TL061 through D1.

sources.title: ElectroSmash, 'MXR MicroAmp Analysis' (BOM C1 0.1u, C2 47p, C3 4.7u, C4 1u, C5 15u, D1 1N4001, R1 22M, R2 10M, R3 1K, R4 56K, R5 500K reverse-log pot, R6 2.7K, R7/R8 100K, R9 470, R10 10K, U1 TL061; gain table 0-500 kΩ -> 21.7x to 1.11x; output network 539 Ω; TL061/071/081 family)
ElectroSmash op-amp-stage schematic (component placement and topology cross-check: C3 4.7u + R6 2.7K in the ground leg, R5 500k pot, C2 47p across R4 56K, R9 470 / R10 10K output divider)

TL061.note: TL061 single low-power BiFET: 1 MHz GBW, 3.5 V/µs slew, ~2e5 open-loop gain (TI datasheet SLOS081). vhi = 9 V battery less D1's ~0.7 V forward drop; the model's 1.5 V swing margin each side leaves about 6.8 Vpp at the output. unverified: the exact open-loop gain and output swing at 9 V are not in the datasheet; TL061 is the stock device, TL071 a drop-in

controls.label: Boost
controls.note: 500 kΩ reverse-log gain pot (R5) in the feedback ground leg. Catalogue 'B' is 0.14-1.0; mapped onto the full 0-500 kΩ track so the preset's 0.14 is the near-unity end and 1.0 the 26 dB end. C taper = the engine's reverse log

parts.label: 9 V battery behind the reverse-polarity diode (rail 8.42 V)
parts.note: The real pedal's D1 (1N4001) sits in series between the battery + and the board rail; at the circuit's ~0.1 mA draw it drops a constant 0.58 V, so the rail is modelled as the 8.42 V the full circuit (with D1) settles to. The series diode has no audio effect (its current is steady) and keeping it made the rail cut fail Newton once per run.

parts.label: Boost 500 kΩ reverse-log (rheostat: wiper tied to top end)
